name: The Walt Disney Company
monetization: Media and IP owner; its AI exposure is as a licensor of characters/IP to generative-AI platforms — an announced $1B OpenAI equity-plus-IP-license deal (Dec 2025) was withdrawn in Mar 2026 with $0 delivered.
description_md: Disney entered the AI money map in December 2025 with a planned $1B investment in OpenAI paired with a three-year license allowing Sora to generate videos from 200+ Disney, Marvel, Pixar, and Star Wars characters. OpenAI shut down the Sora app in March 2026 (Disney was informed less than an hour before the public announcement) and Disney withdrew the investment before any money moved — the tracker's cleanest cautionary example of commitment vs. realized.
